A modest '''population center''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]].<ref name="DL" /> By the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had established a [[Jaguada garrison|garrison]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in the planet's population center<ref name="DL" /> ostensibly to recover stores of war machines left behind by the Separatists on the planet<ref name="CSWE" /> and its [[Jaguada's moon|moon]].<ref name="DL" />
